_comment: Speeds MSFS does not expose as SimVars (Vfe, Vno), per aircraft, in knots (KIAS), from the published POH figures. Matched against the aircraft folder name (regular expression, case-insensitive), first match wins. Vs0, Vs1 and Vne (barber pole) always come from the sim itself. Unknown aircraft: the client estimates Vfe ~ 2.1 x Vs0 and Vno ~ Vne / 1.25 and labels them as estimates.
